direction.label: uptrend
direction.window: close vs EMA20 vs EMA50, daily closes
direction.thresholds: uptrend: close > EMA20 > EMA50; downtrend: close < EMA20 < EMA50; else mixed (ties = mixed)

strength.label: weak
strength.thresholds: weak: ADX < 20; moderate: 20 <= ADX < 25; strong: ADX >= 25

momentum.label: bullish
momentum.thresholds: overbought: RSI >= 70; bullish: 55-70; neutral: 45-55; bearish: 30-45; oversold: RSI <= 30

gex_profile_shape.thresholds: concentrated: HHI >= 0.35; mixed: 0.15-0.35; dispersed: < 0.15 | above_skewed: balance >= +0.20; balanced: -0.20..+0.20; below_skewed: <= -0.20

flow_vs_positioning.flow_basis: today's session cumulative option volume, unsigned (no buy/sell side), full chain, captured at the last chain snapshot

atr.method: simple mean of true range over the last n bars (not Wilder-smoothed)

iv_rank.window_descriptor: 5 of the last 252 sessions (5 accumulated; floor 20)
iv_rank.basis_descriptor: constant-maturity 30-day ATM IV, interpolated from the term-structure curve
iv_rank.advisory_note: Advisory context - where current implied volatility sits within this ticker's own recently-accumulated history. Not a forecast, not a scored signal, not a guarantee.

vol_normalized_gex.basis_note: Net GEX ÷ ATM IV (decimal). Dollar GEX is sized for a fixed 1% shock; dividing by ATM IV makes magnitude comparable across vol regimes. Walls/flip stay raw levels. Not a scoring input.

setups.name: Gamma-flip transition
setups.rationale: Price within 1% of zero-gamma $771.30; a cross flips the regime and tends to expand volatility.

setups.name: Trend regime
setups.rationale: Negative gamma: moves tend to extend. Favor breakouts; do not fade levels.

setups.name: Pin confluence
setups.rationale: Gamma magnet $760.00 and max pain $755.00 coincide near price -> stronger pin.

signals.regime_note: Dealers short gamma -> hedging amplifies moves; trending / breakout-prone.

off_exchange.note: Off-exchange/TRF prints over a recent window; side & intent unknown, includes internalized retail. Use as context, not a directional signal.
